R&D and production base:
● The company has an independent R&D and production base, equipped with full-process experimental instruments and production equipment. It handles manufacturing from bulk metal raw materials to finished products, and product performance meets or exceeds comparable imported products from abroad.
● The company focuses on the processing and manufacturing field, with a commitment to meeting the needs of part joining and sealing. We can provide customized product development for customers' differentiated requirements, along with ongoing technical support and solution services.
● The company's products and solutions are widely used in everyday consumer fields such as home appliances, bathroom fixtures, and kitchenware; in industrial manufacturing fields such as automotive parts, cutting tools and abrasives, mold manufacturing, and mechanical electronics; and in high-end equipment fields such as aerospace and defense. At the same time, we focus on R&D and supply for key infrastructure such as data centers and computing infrastructure, thermal management and AI liquid-cooling welding materials, and power devices. We are committed to providing professional, efficient solutions for metal packaging, joining, and thermal management systems in the above fields.

提供专业、高效的解决方案。
